notes:
## Better
- Setting names you gave are never lost when Windows or antivirus holds the names file for a moment.
- Names imported from PSdZData now remember their CAFD version, so a name from another version is no longer shown as BMW's.
- Backups wait until E-Sys has finished writing before they copy, and a half-written backup is never left behind.
- The car report no longer opens after you cancel it.
- The remote car address now accepts a name (like a DDNS address) as well as an IP address.
- Service reset and Service functions open without a pause.
- Revert all and Discard edits in the NCD editor now default to Cancel.
